scope: Fifty independent evidence passes over real injection-moulding measurements. This registry stores provenance and measurement relationships only; it contains no production recipes, acceptance limits, machine-control authority, or synthetic rows presented as measured data.

passes.sourceTitle: Industrial injection/blow moulding process and quality dataset
passes.learningUse: Benchmark schema discovery, missingness, grouping and process-quality association without assuming causality.
passes.limitation: Injection and blow-moulding records must remain separated and field semantics must be verified from the publisher files.

passes.sourceTitle: Injection Molding Dataset (Viscometer, Euromap77, Quality Table)
passes.learningUse: Test whether repeated cycles and time-resolved pressure expose variation hidden by scalar settings.
passes.limitation: Only 68 experiments are described; conclusions must stay tied to this machine/material/test design.

passes.sourceTitle: Injection Molding Process Data for Post-Consumer-Recycled Materials
passes.learningUse: Compare virgin and post-consumer-recycled material under cavity-pressure and part-mass control using real time-series evidence.
passes.limitation: Controller experiments are not universal recipes and cannot establish transferability to other machines, tools or PCR grades.

passes.sourceTitle: FORinFPRO-HIMD multimodal hybrid injection-moulding sensor dataset
passes.learningUse: Study synchronized machine, pressure-temperature, ultrasound and dielectric evidence through fill, hold and cooling.
passes.limitation: Hybrid continuous-fibre polypropylene behaviour is a specialised process and should not be generalized to unfilled thermoplastics.

passes.sourceTitle: Cross-process-chain dataset archive: injection molding and screw driving
passes.learningUse: Test whether upstream moulding variation carries measurable information into downstream assembly quality.
passes.limitation: Cross-process associations are not proof of a single upstream root cause without controlled intervention evidence.

passes.sourceTitle: Online Prediction of Molded Part Quality Using High-Resolution Time Series
passes.learningUse: Prefer full high-resolution dynamics when they outperform scalar summaries for quality prediction.
passes.limitation: Prediction accuracy does not by itself identify physical causation.

passes.sourceTitle: In-cavity pressure measurements for failure diagnosis and correlation with simulation
passes.learningUse: Use curve location and timing to distinguish filling/switchover failure signatures rather than reacting to one peak value.
passes.limitation: Failure signatures remain tool/material/context dependent.

passes.sourceTitle: Quality Characterization of Micro-Injection Products Based on Cavity Pressure
passes.learningUse: Teach why pressure-time area can carry more quality information than an isolated peak.
passes.limitation: The reported correlation belongs to the tested micro-moulding setup and is not a universal acceptance rule.

passes.sourceTitle: Real-time product weight estimation based on internal pressure monitoring
passes.learningUse: Show that equal pressure integrals can correspond to different weights when the holding condition changes.
passes.limitation: A fitted saturation relation must be revalidated for each material/tool/process context.

passes.sourceTitle: Experimental effect of injection-moulding parameters on cavity pressure and product weight
passes.learningUse: Use controlled factor changes to separate process-input effects on cavity response and mass.
passes.limitation: Factor effects cannot be copied as universal production settings.

passes.sourceTitle: Injection Barrel/Nozzle/Mold-Cavity Scientific Real-Time Sensing and Quality Monitoring
passes.learningUse: Teach pressure-loss-chain reasoning and material-specific rheology monitoring across machine-to-cavity locations.
passes.limitation: Similar melt-flow index does not imply identical polymer response; exact material context matters.

passes.sourceTitle: Adaptive quality monitoring for materials with different viscosity
passes.learningUse: Separate material-viscosity evidence from clamping/load evidence and use actual sensor response rather than settings alone.
passes.limitation: Adaptive-control results do not authorize automatic changes outside the validated setup.

passes.sourceTitle: Online quality monitoring of molten resin in injection molding
passes.learningUse: Compare pressure features at multiple flow-path locations to diagnose resin/process variation.
passes.limitation: Derived indices are model features, not standalone root-cause proof.

passes.sourceTitle: Adaptive process control of the changeover point for injection molding
passes.learningUse: Use measured melt-response change to explain why a fixed transfer position may not reproduce a fixed physical state.
passes.limitation: The control law is study-specific and not a generic transfer recipe.

passes.sourceTitle: Scientific Molding and Adaptive Process Quality Control with External Sensors
passes.learningUse: Connect scientific setup order with external actual-value evidence and long-run verification.
passes.limitation: Study optimization order and control actions must not be treated as universal machine instructions.

passes.sourceTitle: Multiple In-Mold Sensors for Quality and Process Control in Injection Molding
passes.learningUse: Preserve cavity identity and compare local pressure behaviour before averaging multicavity data.
passes.limitation: Sensor locations and cavity geometry influence feature meaning.

passes.sourceTitle: Integrated Capacitance-Pressure-Temperature Sensing Probe for Injection Molding Monitoring
passes.learningUse: Add material-state sensing to pressure/temperature and test whether dielectric response improves quality interpretation.
passes.limitation: Capacitance response depends on material and sensor geometry and requires calibration.

passes.sourceTitle: Integrated capacitance-pressure-temperature sensor for shrinkage estimation and leakage detection
passes.learningUse: Treat abnormal cross-sensor relationships as evidence of a changed physical state rather than trusting one channel.
passes.limitation: An anomaly signature does not identify a universal maintenance threshold.

passes.sourceTitle: Adaptive transfer learning with C-P-T sensor fusion for few-shot anomaly diagnosis
passes.learningUse: Study which sensor relationships survive machine/material transfer and which require re-learning.
passes.limitation: Classification performance is not a substitute for engineering verification of the physical cause.

passes.sourceTitle: On-line measurement of cavity pressure via ultrasonic investigation of tie bar
passes.learningUse: Teach indirect pressure sensing and the need to calibrate structural proxies against independent measurements.
passes.limitation: Tie-bar/clamp configuration affects calibration; indirect pressure must not be assumed transferable.

passes.sourceTitle: Machine Learning in Injection Molding: An Industry 4.0 Method of Quality Prediction
passes.learningUse: Use pressure-derived features for classification while retaining cavity identity and uncertainty.
passes.limitation: High classification accuracy does not make the model a causal diagnostic authority.

passes.sourceTitle: Quality Classification of Injection-Molded Components by Quality Indices, Grading, and Machine Learning
passes.learningUse: Preserve an explicit uncertain/to-be-confirmed region instead of forcing every observation into pass/fail.
passes.limitation: Model grades depend on the study's measurement and quality definitions.

passes.sourceTitle: Novel Analysis Methodology of Cavity Pressure Profiles Using Interpretation of Machine Learning Model
passes.learningUse: Link model-important pressure regions back to physical phases rather than treating ML as a black box.
passes.limitation: Feature importance is associative and requires physical confirmation.

passes.sourceTitle: Data-driven quality prediction in injection molding: autoencoder and machine-learning approach
passes.learningUse: Retain full curve information when compact learned representations improve prediction over hand-picked scalar features.
passes.limitation: Latent features need interpretation before they can support mechanism-level education.

passes.sourceTitle: Monitoring and dynamic control of quality stability for injection molding process
passes.learningUse: Separate monitoring/prediction from intervention and verify quality recovery after a controlled change.
passes.limitation: Closed-loop results belong to the validated system and do not authorize unsupervised control in MouldMaster.

passes.sourceTitle: Local mold temperature control using cartridge heater to improve weld line quality
passes.learningUse: Demonstrate a measured local thermal intervention followed by a physical weld-line quality response.
passes.limitation: Heater geometry, polymer and tool heat transfer are local to the study.

passes.sourceTitle: Impact of mold temperature distribution on warpage of injection-molded parts
passes.learningUse: Tie asymmetric/local thermal state to measured geometric distortion rather than treating average mold temperature as sufficient.
passes.limitation: Warpage response remains geometry/material dependent.

passes.sourceTitle: Mold cavity temperature estimation from transient heat-transfer measurements
passes.learningUse: Teach that surface/cavity temperature during the cycle is dynamic and cannot be reduced to one controller setpoint.
passes.limitation: Sensor construction and thermal model assumptions require validation for another tool.

passes.sourceTitle: Pressure and temperature measurements along an injection molding flow path
passes.learningUse: Show coupled pressure/temperature evolution and why sensor position changes interpretation.
passes.limitation: Flow-path geometry and material rheology constrain transferability.

passes.sourceTitle: Experimental validation of injection-molding cooling/warpage simulation
passes.learningUse: Prefer simulations that are checked against physical geometry/thermal measurements before they support educational claims.
passes.limitation: Validation range and tool/material geometry remain bounded.

passes.sourceTitle: Influence of cavity-pressure sensor location in micro injection molding
passes.learningUse: Teach that a pressure trace is meaningful only with sensor location and flow-front context.
passes.limitation: Micro-scale flow and thermal behavior should not be generalized directly to conventional parts.

passes.sourceTitle: Variotherm injection molding for microfeature replication
passes.learningUse: Connect controlled surface-temperature history with physical replication outcome.
passes.limitation: Feature scale, polymer and surface geometry constrain the result.

passes.sourceTitle: Vacuum-assisted injection molding effects on micro/nano replication
passes.learningUse: Teach cavity-gas boundary conditions as a measured factor in incomplete replication/fill behavior.
passes.limitation: Vacuum-system design and feature geometry determine the effect.

passes.sourceTitle: Experimental effects of cavity thickness on pressure and flow in injection molding
passes.learningUse: Use geometry as an explicit context variable when interpreting pressure/filling difficulty.
passes.limitation: Results are bounded by tested thickness, polymer and tool geometry.

passes.sourceTitle: Experimental study of cavity air pressure/venting during injection molding
passes.learningUse: Make trapped-gas evidence explicit instead of treating burn/incomplete-fill symptoms as pressure-only problems.
passes.limitation: Air-pressure sensing and vent design are tool-specific.

passes.sourceTitle: Batch-to-batch material variation and injection molding process response
passes.learningUse: Teach that equal machine settings can represent different physical processes after material-lot change.
passes.limitation: Batch identity is evidence context, not a universal defect cause.

passes.sourceTitle: Injection-molding process monitoring under regrind/material changes
passes.learningUse: Preserve recycled/regrind content as a grouping variable before attributing process drift to the machine or tool.
passes.limitation: Regrind history and contamination vary between sites/materials.

passes.sourceTitle: Operating-condition and viscosity changes in injection molding monitored by cavity response
passes.learningUse: Use measured response shifts to distinguish changed material/process state from unchanged nominal settings.
passes.limitation: Viscosity indicators require process/location context.

passes.sourceTitle: Experimental fibre orientation and warpage in injection-molded short-fibre composites
passes.learningUse: Connect measured orientation anisotropy to directional shrinkage/warpage rather than using scalar shrinkage reasoning alone.
passes.limitation: Fibre length, loading, grade and geometry matter.

passes.sourceTitle: Measured weld-line behavior in glass-fibre-reinforced injection-molded polymers
passes.learningUse: Treat reinforcement/fibre orientation as part of weld-line structural interpretation.
passes.limitation: Appearance alone is not a strength measurement and grade-specific results are not universal.

passes.sourceTitle: Weld-line geometry and tensile response in injection molding
passes.learningUse: Separate visible weld-line appearance from measured structural consequence.
passes.limitation: Mechanical severity depends on polymer, reinforcement, flow history and specimen geometry.

passes.sourceTitle: Local temperature intervention and weld-line strength in injection molding
passes.learningUse: Use controlled thermal/process changes with physical mechanical outcomes to teach weld-line healing limits.
passes.limitation: Study geometry and polypropylene context bound transferability.

passes.sourceTitle: Strength and durability of injection-moulded weld lines in unreinforced and short-glass-fibre polypropylene
passes.learningUse: Teach that weld-line risk can appear in fatigue/durability even when a short-term visual inspection is insufficient.
passes.limitation: Durability findings remain material/specimen/loading specific.

passes.sourceTitle: Mechanical performance of weld lines in micro injection-molded parts
passes.learningUse: Keep scale/geometry explicit when explaining weld-line strength mechanisms.
passes.limitation: Micro-injection behavior cannot be assumed equivalent to conventional part geometry.

passes.sourceTitle: Quantified injection-molding defect image/segmentation dataset
passes.learningUse: Future benchmark for physically quantified visual defect severity when raw files become available.
passes.limitation: Raw files are not currently available; metadata must not be presented as executed benchmark evidence.

passes.sourceTitle: Experimental energy consumption profile of injection molding cycles
passes.learningUse: Separate cycle-phase energy behavior from part-quality diagnosis and use energy drift as its own evidence family.
passes.limitation: Machine drive architecture and product/cycle configuration affect energy distribution.

passes.sourceTitle: Injection molding energy consumption under machine/process resource changes
passes.learningUse: Show why machine/resource context must accompany energy comparisons.
passes.limitation: Energy results should not be interpreted as a universal quality threshold.

passes.sourceTitle: Injection-moulding production, electrical consumption and tempering-unit dataset
passes.learningUse: Profile real production/resource-state relationships without turning energy anomalies into unsupported moulding root causes.
passes.limitation: Production-state granularity and machine/resource context must be checked in the publisher files before cycle-level claims.

passes.sourceTitle: Measured machine-condition monitoring for injection-molding maintenance
passes.learningUse: Use vibration/state evidence for cycle segmentation and maintenance learning while keeping it separate from direct part-quality diagnosis.
passes.limitation: Sensor mounting, machine family and product mix affect learned signatures.

passes.sourceTitle: Polypropylene injection-moulding process, weight, energy and cycle-time dataset
passes.learningUse: Future joint process-quality-energy benchmark when raw files become available.
passes.limitation: Raw files are not currently available; metadata must not be presented as executed benchmark evidence.
